title: Astro Portal session event payload: device_link_back
description: The link to a smart telescope in mode expérimental is up again after a `device_link_lost`, read only. A reader pairs it with the previous `device_link_lost`. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.
